species: mouse (primary hippocampal neurons, E19); human (HEK293T cells)
readout_other: Fura-2 calcium imaging; c-fos immunostaining; qPCR
direction_notes: Ultrasound evoked Ca2+ influx in NMDA-receptor-expressing HEK293T cells and primary hippocampal neurons and raised c-fos; the effects were reduced by AP-5 and ketamine.
safety_notes: ATP applied after ultrasound still produced a calcium response, taken to show the cells were not damaged.

exposures.label: Ultrasound to cultured hippocampal neurons and HEK293T cells

target.label: primary hippocampal neurons and HEK293T cells

timing.protocol_description: Each stimulus is 400 tone burst pulses at 500 kHz centre frequency and 1 kHz repetition frequency, lasting 400 ms, repeated every 5 s. For c-fos counts neurons received 0.3 MPa ultrasound for 30 min.
